scripts.build: npm run build -w @theahaco/authline -w @g2c/stellar-wallets-kit-module -w @theahaco/authline-relayer && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build -w @theahaco/authline -w @g2c/stellar-wallets-kit-module -w @theahaco/authline-relayer && tsc -b && vite build --mode e2e
scripts.build:e2e:tlo: npm run build:e2e && vite build --mode e2e-tlo --outDir dist/tlo
scripts.build:e2e:eurcv: npm run build:e2e && vite build --mode e2e-eurcv --outDir dist/eurcv
scripts.install:contracts: if ls packages/*/package.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm run build --workspaces --if-present; else echo 'No contract client packages present; skipping install:contracts.'; fi
scripts.test:contracts: RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTFLAGS= cargo test -p trustline-onboard -p trustline-authorizer -p authorizer-stub
scripts.build:contracts: RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTFLAGS= cargo build --release --target wasm32v1-none -p trustline-onboard -p trustline-authorizer
scripts.prove:authorizer: npm run build -w @theahaco/authline && npm run build:contracts && node scripts/prove-authorizer.mjs
